objective: Blindly discover concrete lexical source words whose immediately following numeric value behaves like a recurrent arithmetic summary of preceding numeric entries on heldout documents.

DOC_PREFIX_SUM.definition: For lexical X immediately followed by numeric V, compare V with the exact sum of every numeric-only source word earlier than X in the same document.

ROW_PREFIX_SUM.definition: For lexical X immediately followed by numeric V on the same unambiguous source row, compare V with the exact sum of numeric-only source words earlier than X on that same row.

numeric_arithmetic.representation: exact rational arithmetic for supported integer/decimal/fraction literals
numeric_arithmetic.non-exact-or-unparseable-numeric-like-pi: excluded from arithmetic observations, never coerced

heldout_candidate_gate.null: cross-fitted Poisson-binomial upper tail; each heldout candidate occurrence uses the corresponding train fold's generic arithmetic-match rate for the same operator as its Bernoulli null probability

positive_ladder.R7_B1: unchanged candidate survives full region holdout / cross-region transfer where support permits
positive_ladder.R7_B2: candidate loses its advantage under structure-destroying numeric/order nulls
positive_ladder.R7_B3: probable SUMMARY/TOTAL-LIKE functional-role candidate may be admitted; exact lexical meaning and translation remain forbidden
positive_ladder.EXTERNAL: independent editorial source required before external replication credit

allowed: concrete opaque/source word whose following numeric value recurrently equals a frozen prefix-sum operator on heldout documents
